cards.text: Daniel, an exile from Judah, is on the bank of the Tigris River, and one with the likeness of a man has just strengthened him (Daniel 10:4, 18-19). This one has come to explain what will happen to Daniel's people in the latter days (Daniel 10:14). He starts with the truth: three more kings will arise in Persia, and then a fourth.

cards.question: Persia's fourth king will be far richer than all the others.
By the power of his wealth, Persia's fourth king will stir up everyone against the kingdom of ___.

cards.text: Then a mighty king will arise who will rule with great authority and do as he pleases. But as soon as he's established, his kingdom will be broken up and parceled out toward the four winds of heaven.

cards.question: Once it's broken up, the mighty king's kingdom will go to his descendants.

cards.text: It won't keep the authority he ruled with, because it will be uprooted and given to others. Friend, I KNOW that feeling: one day a shiny new stamper took my spot on the Millers' counter.

cards.question: The king of the South will grow strong, but one of his commanders will grow even stronger. What will that commander do?

answers.text: Rule his own kingdom with great authority
Serve the king of the South loyally
Hand his army over to the North

cards.text: After some years there will be an alliance, and the daughter of the king of the South will go to the king of the North. That's our first look at the king of the North, and trust me, friend, you're gonna see a LOT of him.

cards.question: After some years there will be an alliance. Why will the daughter of the king of the South go to the king of the North?

cards.text: But she won't keep her position of power. She'll be given up, along with her royal escort, her father and the one who supported her.

cards.question: Then one from the daughter's family line will rise up. What will he do to the king of the North?
The one from the daughter's family line will even take the North's ___ captive to Egypt, along with their metal images and their precious vessels of silver and gold.

cards.text: For some years, the one from her family line will stay away from the king of the North, who will invade the South's realm and then go home. Back and forth, back and forth, like two coworkers fighting over the office thermostat.

cards.question: The king of the North's sons will stir up strife. What will they assemble?

cards.text: Their army will advance forcefully, sweeping through like a flood, and will again carry the battle as far as the fortress.

cards.question: The North's army will carry the battle as far as the fortress. What will the king of the South do?

answers.text: March out in a rage to fight

cards.text: The king of the North will raise a large army, but it will be delivered into the hand of his enemy, the king of the South.

cards.question: After casting down tens of thousands, the proud king of the South will triumph.

cards.text: But the king of the North isn't done: after some years, he'll advance with a great army and many supplies. MANY supplies, friend, this is the guy who packs four suitcases for a weekend trip.

cards.question: How will the king of the North's new army compare to the army he lost to the South?

answers.text: It will be larger than the first
It will be smaller than the first
It will be the same size as the first

cards.text: In those times, many will rise up against the king of the South. Violent ones among Daniel's own people will exalt themselves in fulfillment of the vision.

cards.question: The violent ones among Daniel's own people will exalt themselves, but they will ___.

cards.text: Then the king of the North will build up a siege ramp and capture a fortified city. Friend, this man doesn't knock, he builds his OWN staircase up the wall.

cards.question: The king of the North will capture a fortified city. How will the forces of the South hold up?

answers.text: Even their best troops won't be able to resist
Allies from the coastlands will rescue them
They'll drive the North back home

cards.text: The invader will do as he pleases, and no one will stand against him. He'll establish himself in the Beautiful Land, with destruction in his hand.

cards.question: The king of the North will resolve to come with the strength of his whole kingdom and reach an agreement with the king of the South. What will he give him?
The king of the North's plan to overthrow the kingdom by giving a daughter in marriage will succeed.

cards.text: Then the king of the North will turn his face to the coastlands and capture many of them. This man is on a ROLL, friend.

cards.question: After the king of the North captures many of the coastlands, a commander will turn his reproach back upon him.
After that, the king of the North will turn back toward the fortresses of his own land. What will happen to him?

answers.text: He'll stumble and fall and be no more
He'll rebuild a greater army there
He'll rule in peace for many years

cards.text: In his place, one will arise who will send out a tax collector for the glory of the kingdom. I bet nobody throws a parade for THAT guy, friend.

cards.question: Within a few days, the king who sent out the tax collector will be destroyed in battle.

cards.text: Then a despicable person will arise, and royal honors won't be given to him. When your introduction is DESPICABLE, friend, you already know you're not the hero.

cards.question: How will the despicable person get the kingdom?

answers.text: He'll seize it by intrigue in a time of peace
He'll win it in a great battle at sea
The king of the South will hand it to him

cards.text: Then a flood of forces will be swept away before him and destroyed, along with a prince of the covenant.

cards.question: After an alliance is made with the despicable person, he will act honestly.

cards.text: He'll rise to power with only a few people. Then in a time of peace, he'll invade the richest provinces and do what his fathers and forefathers never did.

cards.question: The despicable person will come away with plunder, loot and wealth. What will he do with it?

answers.text: Hide it away in his strongholds
Send it as tribute to the South

cards.text: The despicable person will plot against the strongholds, but only for a time. Then with a large army, he'll stir up his power and his courage against the king of the South, and apparently NOBODY in this vision owns a small army.

cards.question: The king of the South will mobilize a very large and powerful army. What won't he be able to withstand?

answers.text: A sickness spreading through his camp
A storm that wrecks his ships

cards.question: Those who will seek to destroy the king of the South are the ones who eat from his provisions.

cards.text: An army will be swept away, and many will fall slain. And the two kings, their hearts bent on evil, will speak lies at the same table.

cards.question: The two kings will speak lies at the same table, but it will be to no avail. Why?

answers.text: The end will still come at the appointed time
Each king will see through the other's lies
Their own officials will expose them both

cards.text: The king of the North will return to his land with great wealth, but his heart will be set against the holy covenant.
So the king of the North will do damage and return to his own land. Then at the appointed time, he'll invade the South again, but this time won't be like the first.

cards.question: Ships of Kittim will come against the king of the North. How will he respond?

answers.text: He'll lose heart and turn back
He'll sink every one of them

cards.question: After raging against the holy covenant, the king of the North will show favor to those who keep it.

cards.text: His forces will rise up and desecrate the temple fortress. They'll abolish the daily sacrifice and set up the abomination of desolation.

cards.question: With flattery the king of the North will corrupt those who violate the covenant, but the people who know their God will firmly ___ him.

cards.text: Those with insight will instruct many, though for a time they'll fall by sword or flame, or be captured or plundered. When they fall, they'll be granted a little help, but many will join them insincerely.

cards.question: Some of the wise will fall. Why will it happen?

answers.text: So they may be refined and purified
So their enemies may be put to shame
So the city may be spared

cards.text: They'll be refined, purified and made spotless until the time of the end, which will still come at the appointed time. Keep that apron ON, friend, because this vision still has more coming out of the oven.
